verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
The heavens are telling the glory of God
And all creation is shouting for joy

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Come dance in the forest
Come, play in the field
And sing, sing to the glory of the Lord

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Praise for the sun, the bringer of day
He carries the light of the Lord in his rays

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
The moon and the stars
Who light up the way unto your throne

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Praise for the wind that blows through the trees
The seas mighty storms, the gentlest breeze

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
They blow where they will
They blow where they please to please the Lord

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Praise for the rain that waters our fields
And blesses our crops so all the earth yields

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
From death unto life
Her mystery revealed springs forth in joy

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
Praise for the fire who gives us his light
The warmth of the sun to brighten our night

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
He dances with joy
His spirit so bright, he sings of you

verse.name: v5a
verse.lines:
Praise for the earth who makes life to grow,
the creatures you made to let your life show;

verse.name: v5b
verse.lines:
the flowers and trees
that help us to know the heart of love.

verse.name: v6a
verse.lines:
Praise for our death that makes our life real,
the knowledge of loss that helps us to feel;

verse.name: v6b
verse.lines:
the gift of your self,
you presence revealed to bring us home.
